title: Demonstrate accounting for change in accounting estimate including a change in accounting estimate effected by change in accounting principle

items.concept: Prospective change in useful life and residual; multi-year subsequent measurement schedule before/after change; period-end adjusting JEs; disposal
Number-variant twin: prospective life/residual revision; subsequent measurement schedules; period-end JE; disposal with loss
Change from SL to DDB as change in estimate effected by change in principle; prospective DDB subsequent measurement schedule; period-end JEs; income comparison disclosure
Intangible initial recognition; subsequent amortization schedule; prospective life revision; period-end JE; abandonment/disposal write-off
Classification — pure change in estimate vs estimate effected by principle vs retrospective principle change; prospective application
Prospective application of pure change in estimate — no restatement or cumulative catch-up
